```
   GRID_DUMP 产物且 oracle 在 @21 前正确）；js*.slope 三件则是 buildStore 类 rig
   （typ/act/wal/liq 重建、**slope 通道不回注**）的产物——"清零"发生在 rig 构造期。

   __cavesGridExport 休眠钩已扩 slope/half 两通道，tests/caves-checkpoint.test.ts
   :131）：JS 真链 @20/@21/@22 vs 真值 **slope/half差=0、act差=0 全程零差**——
   (2626,234) 在真链里 slope=2 从 @19 存活到 @23，与真值一致；Y 批 _ypipe22
   「@22 slope/half 0 差」结论复核成立。
3. **流收敛复验**（tools/_gflow.test.ts 真链计数）：marble=**248,340 精确**（=vanilla
   N）、granite=**78,137 精确**——FF 的 278,256 是缺 slope 输入时 PlaceSlab
```

```
41	interface Cap { gs: GenState; solid: Map<number, boolean>; aux: { liquidType: Uint8Array; half: Uint8Array; slope: Uint8Array; wire: Uint8Array } }

44	function cloneGs(gs: GenState): GenState {
45	  const c = { ...gs } as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
46	  for (const k of Object.keys(c)) {
47	    const v = c[k];
48	    if (Array.isArray(v)) c[k] = v.map((e) => (e && typeof e === 'object' ? { ...(e as object) } : e));
49	    else if (v instanceof Int32Array) c[k] = v.slice();
50	    else if (v instanceof Float32Array) c[k] = v.slice();
51	    else if (v instanceof Uint8Array) c[k] = v.slice();
52	    else if (v && typeof v === 'object') c[k] = { ...(v as Record<string, unknown>) };
53	  }
54	  return c as unknown as GenState;
55	}

57	function countedRng(seed: number) {
58	  const rng = new RNG(seed);
59	  const ur = (rng as unknown as { ur: { internalSample: () => number } }).ur;
60	  const orig = ur.internalSample.bind(ur);
61	  const box = { n: 0 };
62	  const rolls: Array<[number, string, number, number, number]> = [];
63	  ur.internalSample = () => { box.n++; return orig(); };
64	  // RNG 门面日志：int/next 逐调用记 (k, 调用形, lo, hi, val)
65	  const g = globalThis as { __swRollLog?: Array<[number, string, number, number, number]> };
66	  if (g.__swRollLog) {
67	    for (const key of ['int', 'next'] as const) {
68	      const origFn = (rng[key] as (...a: number[]) => number).bind(rng);
69	      (rng[key] as unknown as (...a: number[]) => number) = (...a: number[]) => {
70	        const v = origFn(...a);
71	        g.__swRollLog!.push([box.n, key, a[0] ?? 0, a[1] ?? 0, v]);
72	        (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN = box.n;
73	        return v;
74	      };
75	    }
76	  }
77	  return { rng, box };
78	}

80	function buildStore(idx: number, cap: Cap): TileStore {
81	  const t = loadT(idx), a = loadA(idx), w = loadW(idx), l = loadL(idx);
82	  // ★辅助通道改用 x86 真值 /tmp/chestd59（尾批 2-B ChestProbe D59：Buried Chests
83	  //   pass 头 slope/half/lty/wire 四通道裸数组——55-58 期间 slope/half 有 5 万格
84	  //   漂移，hs54 已陈旧）。
85	  let hHalf: Uint8Array | null = null, hSlope: Uint8Array | null = null, hLty: Uint8Array | null = null, hWire: Uint8Array | null = null;
86	  try {
87	    // ★尾批 2-C：/tmp/hg/chestd59v2 = SW_EVIL=0 与金标 dump 同跑的四通道（旧
88	    //   /tmp/chestd59 是自然邪恶首跑产物——half 有 10,939 格漂移，曾致落定/锚腿判定分叉）
89	    hHalf = new Uint8Array(readFileSync('/tmp/hg/chestd59v2.half'));
90	    hSlope = new Uint8Array(readFileSync('/tmp/hg/chestd59v2.slope'));
91	    hLty = new Uint8Array(readFileSync('/tmp/hg/chestd59v2.lty'));
92	    hWire = new Uint8Array(readFileSync('/tmp/hg/chestd59v2.wire'));
93	  } catch { /* 缺真值回退管线捕获 */ }
94	  const st = new TileStore(W, H);
95	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
96	    st.type[i] = REV.get(t[i]!) ?? 0;
97	    st.flags[i] = a[i] ? 1 : 0;
98	    st.wall[i] = w[i]!;
99	    st.liquid[i] = l[i]!;
100	    st.liquidType[i] = hLty ? hLty[i] : cap.aux.liquidType[i];       // D59 已按本仓 +1 编码（liquid>0 ? lty+1 : 0）
101	    st.half[i] = hHalf ? hHalf[i] : cap.aux.half[i];
102	    st.slope[i] = hSlope ? hSlope[i] : cap.aux.slope[i];
103	    st.wire[i] = hWire ? hWire[i] : cap.aux.wire[i];
104	  }
105	  return st;
106	}

108	interface DiffRes { typ: number; act: number; wal: number; liq: number; pairs: [string, number][]; samples: string[]; mask: Uint8Array }
109	function diff(st: TileStore, idx: number, label: string, prevMask?: Uint8Array): DiffRes {
110	  const t = loadT(idx), a = loadA(idx), w = loadW(idx), l = loadL(idx);
111	  let typ = 0, act = 0, wal = 0, liq = 0;
112	  const pairs = new Map<string, number>();
113	  const samples: string[] = [];
114	  const mask = new Uint8Array(N);
115	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
116	    let jT = st.type[i]; if (jT !== 0) jT = SHEET[jT] ?? -1;
117	    const dT = jT !== t[i], dA = (st.flags[i] !== 0) !== (a[i] !== 0), dW = st.wall[i] !== w[i], dL = st.liquid[i] !== l[i];
118	    if (!(dT || dA || dW || dL)) continue;
119	    mask[i] = 1;
120	    if (dT) { typ++; pairs.set(`t${jT}>${t[i]}`, (pairs.get(`t${jT}>${t[i]}`) ?? 0) + 1); }
121	    if (dA) { act++; pairs.set(`a${st.flags[i] ? 1 : 0}>${a[i]}`, (pairs.get(`a${st.flags[i] ? 1 : 0}>${a[i]}`) ?? 0) + 1); }
122	    if (dW) { wal++; pairs.set(`W${st.wall[i]}>${w[i]}`, (pairs.get(`W${st.wall[i]}>${w[i]}`) ?? 0) + 1); }
123	    if (dL) liq++;
124	    if (samples.length < 8) samples.push(`(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0})t${jT}>${t[i]}a${st.flags[i] ? 1 : 0}>${a[i]}w${st.wall[i]}>${w[i]}L${st.liquid[i]}>${l[i]}`);
125	  }
126	  const top = [...pairs.entries()].sort((p, q) => q[1] - p[1]).slice(0, 14);
127	  console.log(`${label}: typ=${typ} act=${act} wal=${wal} liq=${liq}`);
128	  console.log('  pairs:', JSON.stringify(top));
129	  console.log('  samples:', samples.join(' | '));
130	  if (prevMask) {
131	    let nt = 0, na = 0, nw = 0, nl = 0;
132	    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
133	      if (!mask[i] || prevMask[i]) continue;
134	      let jT = st.type[i]; if (jT !== 0) jT = SHEET[jT] ?? -1;
135	      if (jT !== t[i]) nt++;
136	      if ((st.flags[i] !== 0) !== (a[i] !== 0)) na++;
137	      if (st.wall[i] !== w[i]) nw++;
138	      if (st.liquid[i] !== l[i]) nl++;
139	    }
140	    console.log(`  new(相对prevMask): typ=${nt} act=${na} wal=${nw} liq=${nl}`);
141	  }
142	  return { typ, act, wal, liq, pairs: top, samples, mask };
143	}

145	/** 足迹对拍：vanilla 改动集（in→out dump）与 JS 改动集（in dump→JS 出）的分渠道计数 + 首/尾分歧点 */
146	function footprints(st: TileStore, inIdx: number, outIdx: number) {
147	  const ti = loadT(inIdx), ai = loadA(inIdx), wi = loadW(inIdx), li = loadL(inIdx);
148	  const to = loadT(outIdx), ao = loadA(outIdx), wo = loadW(outIdx), lo = loadL(outIdx);
149	  const vanT: number[] = [], vanW: number[] = [], jsT: number[] = [], jsW: number[] = [];
150	  const vanList: Array<[number, number, string]> = [], jsList: Array<[number, number, string]> = [];
151	  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
152	    const x = i % W, y = (i / W) | 0;
153	    if (ti[i] !== to[i] || (ai[i] !== 0) !== (ao[i] !== 0) || wi[i] !== wo[i]) {
154	      vanList.push([x, y, `t${ti[i]}${ai[i] ? '*' : '.'}>${to[i]}${ao[i] ? '*' : '.'}w${wi[i]}>${wo[i]}`]);
155	      if (ti[i] !== to[i] || (ai[i] !== 0) !== (ao[i] !== 0)) vanT.push(i);
156	      if (wi[i] !== wo[i]) vanW.push(i);
157	    }
158	    let jT = st.type[i]; if (jT !== 0) jT = SHEET[jT] ?? -1;
159	    const jA = st.flags[i] !== 0;
160	    if (jT !== ti[i] || jA !== (ai[i] !== 0) || st.wall[i] !== wi[i]) {
161	      jsList.push([x, y, `t${ti[i]}${ai[i] ? '*' : '.'}>${jT}${jA ? '*' : '.'}w${wi[i]}>${st.wall[i]}`]);
162	      if (jT !== ti[i] || jA !== (ai[i] !== 0)) jsT.push(i);
163	      if (st.wall[i] !== wi[i]) jsW.push(i);
164	    }
165	  }
166	  console.log(`  足迹: vanilla typ/act格=${vanT.length} wal格=${vanW.length} | JS typ/act格=${jsT.length} wal格=${jsW.length}`);
167	  const vanSet = new Set(vanList.map(([x, y]) => `${x},${y}`));
168	  const jsSet = new Set(jsList.map(([x, y]) => `${x},${y}`));
169	  const onlyVan = vanList.filter(([x, y]) => !jsSet.has(`${x},${y}`));
170	  const onlyJs = jsList.filter(([x, y]) => !vanSet.has(`${x},${y}`));
171	  console.log(`  vanilla-only=${onlyVan.length} (前6: ${onlyVan.slice(0, 6).map((e) => e.join(',')).join(' ')})  JS-only=${onlyJs.length} (前6: ${onlyJs.slice(0, 6).map((e) => e.join(',')).join(' ')})`);
172	  // 首个 onlyJs 事件的 7×7 邻域三视图
173	  if (onlyJs.length) {
174	    const [bx, by] = onlyJs[0]!;
175	    const rows: string[] = [];
176	    for (let dy = -3; dy <= 3; dy++) {
177	      let rI = '', rV = '', rJ = '';
178	      for (let dx = -3; dx <= 3; dx++) {
179	        const i = (by + dy) * W + bx + dx;
180	        rI += `${ti[i] ?? '?'}${ai[i] ? '*' : '.'} `;
181	        rV += `${to[i] ?? '?'}${ao[i] ? '*' : '.'} `;
182	        let jT = st.type[i]; if (jT !== 0) jT = SHEET[jT] ?? -1;
183	        rJ += `${jT}${st.flags[i] ? '*' : '.'} `;
184	      }
185	      rows.push(`y${by + dy}: in[${rI}] van[${rV}] js[${rJ}]`);
186	    }
187	    console.log(`  首JS-only(${bx},${by}) 7×7:\n    ` + rows.join('\n    '));
188	    const near = onlyJs.slice(0, 12).map(([x, y, s]) => `(${x},${y})${s}`);
189	    console.log(`  JS-only 前12: ${near.join(' ')}`);
190	    const nearV = onlyVan.slice(0, 12).map(([x, y, s]) => `(${x},${y})${s}`);
191	    console.log(`  van-only 前12: ${nearV.join(' ')}`);
192	  }
193	}

195	(RUN ? it : it.skip)('chest-family isolated replay', async () => {
196	  // ── A) 真管线捕获 ──
197	  const origReseed = RNG.prototype.reseed;
198	  const WANT = new Set(['UndergroundHousesAndBuriedChests', 'SurfaceChests', 'UnderwaterChests', 'SpiderCaves']);
199	  let store: TileStore | null = null;
200	  const onReseed = function (this: RNG, seed: number) {
201	    origReseed.call(this, seed);
202	    try {
203	      const stackLine = (new Error().stack ?? '').split('\n').find((l) => l.includes('/src/') && !l.includes('rng.ts')) ?? '?';
204	      const mLoc = /\(.*(src\/[^\s?]+):(\d+):\d+\)/.exec(stackLine);
205	      if (!mLoc || !mLoc[1]!.includes('WorldGen.ts') || !store) return;
206	      const abs = `~/Project/GLM/SandboxWorld/game/${mLoc[1]!.slice(mLoc[1]!.indexOf('src/'))}`;
207	      const src = readFileSync(abs, 'utf8').split('\n');
208	      for (let k = +mLoc[2]; k >= Math.max(0, +mLoc[2] - 2); k--) {
209	        const cm = /\/\/\s*▶([^\s(（]+)/.exec(src[k - 1] ?? '');
210	        if (cm && WANT.has(cm[1]!) && !caps[cm[1]!]) {
211	          const gs = lastGenState();
212	          if (!gs) return;
213	          caps[cm[1]!] = {
214	            gs: cloneGs(gs), solid: snapshotGenSolid(),
215	            aux: { liquidType: store.liquidType.slice(), half: store.half.slice(), slope: store.slope.slice(), wire: store.wire.slice() },
216	          };
217	          console.log(`captured @▶${cm[1]}`);
218	        }
219	      }
220	    } catch { /* probe */ }
221	  };
222	  (RNG.prototype as unknown as { reseed: unknown }).reseed = onReseed;
223	  try {
224	    await generateWorld({ width: W, height: H, seedText: '9293480', evil: 0, onWorldPartial: (w) => { store = w.store; } });
225	  } catch (e) {
226	    console.log('pipeline EX(忽略):', String(e).slice(0, 200));
227	  } finally {
228	    (RNG.prototype as unknown as { reseed: unknown }).reseed = origReseed;
229	  }
230	  console.log('caps:', Object.keys(caps).join(','));
231	
232	  // ── B) #58 窗：dump058 → #58 链 → dump059 ──
233	  {
234	    const cap = caps.UndergroundHousesAndBuriedChests!;
235	    const st = buildStore(58, cap);
236	    restoreGenSolid(cap.solid);
237	    const gs = cloneGs(cap.gs);
238	    const chests: ChestSink = [];

240	    const houseEv: Array<[string, number, number, number]> = [];
241	    (globalThis as unknown as { __swHouseEv?: (p: string, x: number, y: number) => void }).__swHouseEv
242	      = (p, x, y) => { houseEv.push([p, x, y, (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN ?? -1]); };
243	    const chestEv: Array<[string, number, number, number]> = [];

245	      = (p, i, j, x) => { chestEv.push([p, i, j, x ?? (globalThis as { __swRollN?: number }).__swRollN ?? -1]); };

257	    console.log(`\n[#58 重放] draws=${box.n} counts=${JSON.stringify(counts)} chests=${chests.length}`);
258	    // 落盘 JS 重放输出 + chests 清单供 python 分析（van N 定标：P59=76364 P60=28810 P62=5495 P63=160186）

297	        .sort((a, b) => (a[1] - b[1]) || (a[0] - b[0]));
```

```
"""FNV(Main.rand state) -> pass-local k（UR(9293480) reseed 后掷数）。"""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/dgu')
from pyur import UR

SEED = 9293480

def fnv(sa, inext):
    h = 2166136261
    M = 0xFFFFFFFF
    for v in sa:
        h = ((h ^ (v & 0xFF)) * 0x1000193) & M
        h = ((h ^ ((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 0x1000193) & M
        h = ((h ^ ((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 0x1000193) & M
        h = ((h ^ ((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 0x1000193) & M
    h = ((h ^ (inext & 0xFF)) * 0x1000193) & M
    h = ((h ^ ((inext >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 0x1000193) & M
    h = ((h ^ ((inext >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 0x1000193) & M
    h = ((h ^ ((inext >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 0x1000193) & M
    return h

def build(kmax=90000):
    u = UR(SEED)
    table = {}
    for k in range(kmax):
        u.internal_sample()
        table[fnv(u.sa, u.inext)] = k + 1  # k+1 掷后的 hash
    return table

if __name__ == '__main__':
    t = build()
    print('size', len(t))
    # sanity: 对照 chest-seg59.json 首事件 AB k=6 hash 缺失——seg 里无 hash，用 ABX|1|<hash> 对拍

        print('probe not ready:', e)
```

```
154	    ['desert', count(SC397) + count(SC396) + count(SC53)],
155	    ['granite', count(SC368)],
156	    ['marble', count(SC367)],
157	  ];
158	  let best: [Theme, number] = scores[0];
159	  for (let i = 1; i < scores.length; i++) if (best[1] < scores[i][1]) best = scores[i];
160	  return best[0];
161	}

163	// ---------- 家具/陈设放置 ----------
164	/** 底锚(bottom)/顶锚(top)放置 framed 物件;帧 = style*fw*18 步长 */
165	function placeFurniture(st: TileStore, key: string, x: number, y: number, style = 0, anchor: 'bottom' | 'top' = 'bottom'): boolean {
166	  const t = TILE_BY_KEY[key];
167	  if (t === undefined) return false;
168	  const d = TILE_DEFS[t];
169	  const fw = d.vanilla?.fw ?? 1;
170	  const w = d.w ?? fw, h = d.h ?? (d.vanilla?.fh ?? 1);
171	  const topY = anchor === 'bottom' ? y - (h - 1) : y;
172	  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
173	    for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
174	      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, topY + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, topY + dy)]) return false;
175	    }
176	  }
177	  // 样式基偏移:权威布局表(FurnitureStyle.ts,竖排/换行族与通用横排统一)
178	  const sheet = d.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1;
179	  const [bx, by] = furnitureStyleBase(sheet, style, fw);
180	  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
181	    for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
182	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, topY + dy, t, bx + dx * 18, by + dy * 18);
183	    }
184	  }
185	  return true;
186	}

188	/** 雕像(2×3,style*36 步长);STATUES_WITH_TRAPS 命中 → 邻近飞镖陷阱+接线 */
189	function placeStatue(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, idx: number): boolean {
190	  const [sheet, style] = STATUE_LIST[idx];
191	  const tile = sheet === 349 ? STATUE_349 : STATUE_105;
192	  if (!tile || !st.inBounds(x + 1, y - 2)) return false;
193	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
194	    for (let dy = -2; dy <= 0; dy++) {
195	      if (st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return false;
196	    }
197	  }
198	  // 雕像帧换行（Place2xX case 105，cs:39716-39720）：每行 55 列——
199	  // frameX=(style%55)*36、frameY=floor(style/55)*54（与 StatuesPass 同实现；
200	  // 此前单轴 style*36，style≥55 越界错位）
201	  const row = Math.floor(style / 55);
202	  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
203	    for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) {
204	      st.setTileSilent(x + dx, y - 2 + dy, tile, (style - row * 55) * 36 + dx * 18, row * 54 + dy * 18);
205	    }
206	  }
207	  if (STATUES_WITH_TRAPS.has(idx)) placeStatueTrap(st, x, y);
208	  return true;
209	}

211	// ---------- 画(RandHousePicture cs:35336 / Desert cs:35286) ----------
212	const PIC_240 = [26, 28, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, 33, 34, 35, 76, 77, 78, 79, 82, 96, 98, 100];
213	const PIC_245 = [0, 3, 5, 6, 14, -1, 19, 20, 21]; // -1 → 15+rng(4)
214	const PIC_246 = [1, 30, 31, 32, 33, 34, 35, 36];
215	function randHousePicture(rng: RNG): [string, number] {
216	  let n = rng.int(0, 3);
217	  if (n >= 3 && rng.int(0, 1) !== 0) n = rng.int(0, 2);
218	  if (n <= 1) return ['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3', PIC_240[rng.int(0, 17)]];
219	  if (n === 2) {
220	    let s = rng.int(0, 8);
221	    if (s === 0 && rng.int(0, 2) !== 0) s = rng.int(0, 8);
222	    const style = s === 5 ? 15 + rng.int(0, 3) : PIC_245[s];
223	    return ['v_245_paintings_2x3', style];
224	  }
225	  return ['v_246_paintings_3x2', PIC_246[rng.int(0, 7)]];
226	}
227	function randHousePictureDesert(rng: RNG): [string, number] {
228	  const n = rng.int(0, 3);
229	  if (n <= 1) return ['v_240_wall_hangings_3x3', [63, 64, 65, 66, 67, 68][rng.int(0, 5)]];
230	  if (n === 2) return ['v_245_paintings_2x3', 7 + rng.int(0, 1)];
231	  return ['v_242_paintings_6x4', 37 + rng.int(0, 5)];
232	}

234	// ---------- 原版 GenAction 链 1:1 解释器(Modifiers.cs / Actions.cs 逐条核实) ----------
235	// 三条权威语义(旧实现全部踩错,修复根因):
236	//  · Dither(p)(Modifiers.cs:621-635):p 是【失败率】——NextDouble() >= p 才放行,
237	//    即 Dither(0.85) 通过率仅 15%。旧实现把 0.85 当通过率(< 0.85 即过),七主题
238	//    蚀变量级整体取反(C1)。
239	//  · Blotches(Modifiers.cs:92-152,Apply :131-152):每点【先丢 1 掷】,再
240	//    NextDouble() < chance 决定是否成斑;成斑再掷 4 次(Next(1-minX,1)/Next(0,maxX)/
241	//    Next(1-minY,1)/Next(0,maxY))并把后续链应用到随机矩形(会外溢房外);未成斑
242	//    则原点继续。旧实现用自制哈希值噪声替斑,分布与掷骰数都不对(C2)。
243	//  · 链序 = 掷骰序:Dither/Blotches 永远排在 OnlyTiles/OnlyWalls 之前
244	//    (各 *HouseBuilder.cs AgeRoom),对房间矩形内每格都掷,失败短路后不耗 RNG(C3);
245	//    墙动作的 worldSurface 二选一按【房间】room.Y 判定(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36 /
246	//    IceHouseBuilder.cs:32),非逐格。
247	type ChainStep =
248	  | { k: 'dither'; p: number }                                            // Modifiers.Dither
249	  | { k: 'blotches'; minX: number; maxX: number; minY: number; maxY: number; chance: number } // Modifiers.Blotches
250	  | { k: 'onlyTiles'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.OnlyTiles(Modifiers.cs:238)
251	  | { k: 'onlyWalls'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.OnlyWalls(Modifiers.cs:216)
252	  | { k: 'skipTiles'; types: number[] }                                   // Modifiers.SkipTiles(Modifiers.cs:392)
253	  | { k: 'isEmpty' }                                                      // Modifiers.IsEmpty(Modifiers.cs:539)
254	  | { k: 'offset'; dx: number; dy: number }                               // Modifiers.Offset(Modifiers.cs:603)
255	  | { k: 'setTileKeepWall'; tile: number }                                // Actions.SetTileKeepWall(Actions.cs:272)
256	  | { k: 'setTile'; tile: number }                                        // Actions.SetTile(Actions.cs:203)
257	  | { k: 'clearTile' }                                                    // Actions.ClearTile(Actions.cs:155)
258	  | { k: 'clearWall'; frame?: boolean }                                   // Actions.ClearWall(Actions.cs:171；frame=true → 四邻 SquareWallFrame 掷)
259	  | { k: 'placeWall'; wall: number }                                      // Actions.PlaceWall(Actions.cs:516)
260	  | { k: 'stalagtite' }                                                   // ActionStalagtite → WorldGen.PlaceTight
261	  | { k: 'vines'; min: number; max: number; vine: number };               // ActionVines
262	
263	// ---------- 墙重帧掷（尾批 2-C ★房屋链欠掷 5 万主根因）----------
264	// Actions.PlaceWall/ClearWall(frameNeighbors:true) → WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(x,y)
265	// 【resetFrame:true 默认】→ Framing.WallFrame 中心格掷 Next(0,3)（Framing.cs:388-397，
266	// wallFrameNumber 重置）；墙 21 命中再掷 Next(2)。SquareWallFrame 本体对 8 邻格用
267	// resetFrame:false（零掷）。豁免：wall==0（早退）/wallLargeFrames∈{1,2}（查表分支
268	// 零掷——Main.cs:9652+ 全表 {224,323-330,179,146,147,167,185,274,354,355,358,359,
269	// 362,363,366}）。PlaceWall.Apply 序（Actions.cs:528-538）：置墙 → SquareWallFrame(x,y)
270	// → (x+1,y)/(x-1,y)/(x,y-1)/(x,y+1) 四邻（各中心格按彼时墙值判定掷否）。
271	// ClearWall(true) 同四邻序、无自格（WorldUtils.cs:67-76）。
272	const WALL_LARGE_FRAMES = new Set([224, 323, 324, 325, 326, 327, 328, 329, 330, 179, 146, 147, 167, 185, 274, 354, 355, 358, 359, 362, 363, 366]);
273	/** SquareWallFrame(x,y,resetFrame=true) 的中心格掷骰语义（结果不入墙帧——仅保流） */
274	function wallFrameResetRoll(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
275	  if (x <= 0 || y <= 0 || x >= st.w - 1 || y >= st.h - 1) return;  // Framing.WallFrame 边界早退
276	  const w = st.wall[st.idx(x, y)];
277	  if (w === 0) return;                    // 墙 0 → 无掷
278	  if (WALL_LARGE_FRAMES.has(w)) return;   // 大帧墙查表分支 → 无掷
279	  rng.int(0, 2);                          // num2 = Next(0,3)
280	  if (w === 21) rng.int(0, 1);            // 墙 21 花墙 → Next(2)
281	}
282	/** Actions.PlaceWall（neighbors=true 恒真）逐格掷序 */
283	function placeWallRolled(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, wall: number): void {
284	  st.setWallSilent(x, y, wall);
285	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y);
286	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x + 1, y);
287	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x - 1, y);
288	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y - 1);
289	  wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y + 1);
290	}
291	
292	/** GenAction.Apply 第 i 步 @ (x,y),失败短路返回 false(不执行后续步骤、不耗 RNG) */
293	function applyChain(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], i: number, x: number, y: number): boolean {
294	  if (i >= steps.length) return true;
295	  const s = steps[i];
296	  switch (s.k) {
297	    case 'dither':
298	      // Modifiers.cs:630-635:NextDouble() >= _failureChance 才 UnitApply
299	      return rng.next() >= s.p && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
300	    case 'blotches': {
301	      rng.next();                                                    // 丢 1 掷(Modifiers.cs:132)
302	      if (rng.next() < s.chance) {                                   // 成斑判定(:133)
303	        const x0 = rng.int(1 - s.minX, 0);                           // Next(1-minX, 1)(:136)
304	        const x1 = rng.int(0, s.maxX - 1);                           // Next(0, maxX)(:137)
305	        const y0 = rng.int(1 - s.minY, 0);                           // Next(1-minY, 1)(:138)
306	        const y1 = rng.int(0, s.maxY - 1);                           // Next(0, maxY)(:139)
307	        let ok = true;                                               // flag |= !UnitApply(:140-145)
308	        for (let dx = x0; dx <= x1; dx++) {
309	          for (let dy = y0; dy <= y1; dy++) {
310	            if (!applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + dx, y + dy)) ok = false;
311	          }
312	        }
313	        return ok;
314	      }
315	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);                // 未成斑原点继续(:148)
316	    }
317	    case 'onlyTiles': {
318	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return false;                         // !active → Fail(:245)
319	      const t = st.type[st.idx(x, y)];
320	      return s.types.includes(t) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
321	    }
322	    case 'onlyWalls':
323	      // Blotches 扇出可外溢房外 1 格,读前兜底(房间本体 InWorld 10 边距本已安全)
324	      return st.inBounds(x, y) && s.types.includes(st.wall[st.idx(x, y)])
325	        && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
326	    case 'skipTiles': {
327	      if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y); // !active 放行(:399)
328	      return !s.types.includes(st.type[st.idx(x, y)]) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
329	    }
330	    case 'isEmpty':
331	      return !activeAt(st, x, y) && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
332	    case 'offset':
333	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x + s.dx, y + s.dy);
334	    case 'setTileKeepWall':
335	      // Actions.cs:272-301:清块保墙(墙由本仓墙段独立处理)+ type + active,恒成功
336	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, s.tile);
337	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
338	    case 'setTile':
339	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, s.tile);
340	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
341	    case 'clearTile':
342	      st.setTileSilent(x, y, 0);
343	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
344	    case 'clearWall':
345	      // WorldUtils.ClearWall(x,y,frame)：清墙后 frame=true 时四邻 SquareWallFrame
346	      // （中心格掷——尾批 2-C 墙重帧掷模型）；frame 缺省 false（蘑菇 ③）零掷
347	      st.setWallSilent(x, y, 0);
348	      if (s.frame) {
349	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x + 1, y);
350	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x - 1, y);
351	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y - 1);
352	        wallFrameResetRoll(st, rng, x, y + 1);
353	      }
354	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
355	    case 'placeWall':
356	      placeWallRolled(st, rng, x, y, s.wall);
357	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
358	    case 'stalagtite':
359	      placeTight(st, rng, x, y);                                     // ActionStalagtite 恒 UnitApply
360	      return applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
361	    case 'vines': {
362	      // ActionVines.cs:21-35:len=Next(min,max+1);逐格向下铺到实心;i>0 才算成功
363	      const len = rng.int(s.min, s.max);
364	      let placed = 0;
365	      for (let k = 0; k < len && st.inBounds(x, y + k) && !activeAt(st, x, y + k); k++) {
366	        st.setTileSilent(x, y + k, s.vine, 0, 0);
367	        placed++;
368	      }
369	      return placed > 0 && applyChain(st, rng, steps, i + 1, x, y);
370	    }
371	  }
372	}
373	
374	/** WorldUtils.Gen + Shapes.Rectangle(Shapes.cs Rectangle.Perform):x 外层 / y 内层 */
375	function genRect(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, steps: ChainStep[], ox: number, oy: number, w: number, h: number): void {
376	  for (let x = ox; x < ox + w; x++) {
377	    for (let y = oy; y < oy + h; y++) applyChain(st, rng, steps, 0, x, y);
378	  }
379	}
380	
381	// ---------- 钟乳石(WorldGen.PlaceTight 1:1) ----------
382	/** PlaceUncheckedStalactite 的冰分支(cs:38377-38405):上方 ∈{147,161,163,164,200}
383	 *  才放置;其余名单(石/苔/沙等)在地下屋场景上方是主题块,恒静默返回 */
384	function placeUncheckedStalactite(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, preferSmall: boolean, variation: number): void {
385	  if (!solidAt(st, x, y - 1) || activeAt(st, x, y) || activeAt(st, x, y + 1)) return;
386	  const above = st.type[st.idx(x, y - 1)];
387	  if (above !== SNOW147 && above !== ICE161
388	    && above !== TILE_BY_KEY['v_163_corrupt_ice_block']! && above !== sheetTile(164)
389	    && above !== TILE_BY_KEY['v_200_crimson_ice_block']!) return;
390	  // 冰族专属列（GetDesiredStalagtiteStyle :38800-38808 重定型）：147/161→0、
391	  // 163→594、164→540、200→648——曾全写 fx0 冰柱列（163/164/200 错列）
392	  const base = above === SNOW147 || above === ICE161 ? 0
393	    : above === TILE_BY_KEY['v_163_corrupt_ice_block']! ? 594
394	    : above === sheetTile(164) ? 540 : 648;
395	  if (preferSmall) {
396	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 72);
397	  } else {
398	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 0);
399	    st.setTileSilent(x, y + 1, STALACTITE, base + variation * 18, 18);
400	  }
401	}
402	
403	/** WorldGen.PlaceTight(cs:38329-38351):231 幼虫(及 shimmer,生成期无来源)短路,
404	 *  其余【恒先掷 2 次】Next(2)/Next(3) 再走 PlaceUncheckedStalactite——名单外静默
405	 *  返回但掷骰照耗(沙漠/花岗岩/大理石的 ActionStalagtite 行因此也要走这里) */
406	function placeTight(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number): void {
407	  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
408	  const i = st.idx(x, y);
409	  if (st.flags[i] !== 0 && st.type[i] === LARVA231) return;
410	  const preferSmall = rng.int(0, 1) === 0;
411	  const variation = rng.int(0, 2);
412	  placeUncheckedStalactite(st, x, y, preferSmall, variation);
413	}
414	
415	/** AgeRoom 七主题蚀变:逐主题把原版 WorldUtils.Gen 链逐条转录(行号 = 各
416	 *  *HouseBuilder.cs AgeRoom)。Dither/Blotches 语义见 applyChain 头注(C1/C2/C3) */
417	function ageRoom(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, r: Rect, theme: Theme, def: ThemeDef): void {
418	  // Blotches(scale=2)→ minX=maxX=minY=maxY=2(Modifiers.cs:95-100)
419	  const B2 = (chance: number): ChainStep => ({ k: 'blotches', minX: 2, maxX: 2, minY: 2, maxY: 2, chance });
420	  // 墙段收尾:room.Y > worldSurface 时清墙、否则铺墙——按【房间】整体二选一
421	  // (WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36 / IceHouseBuilder.cs:32 的三元表达式在链构造时求值)
422	  const wallTail = (surfaceWall: number): ChainStep[] => [
423	    { k: 'skipTiles', types: SKIP_AGING_TILES },
424	    r.y > gs.worldSurface ? { k: 'clearWall', frame: true } : { k: 'placeWall', wall: surfaceWall },
425	  ];
426	
427	  if (theme === 'wood') {
428	    // ① 蛛网(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:30-35):W*H/16 次,每处 2×2 矩形跑
429	    //   Dither(0.5)+Blotches(2,2,chance 0.3)+IsEmpty+SetTile(51)
430	    const count = Math.floor(r.w * r.h / 16);
431	    for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) {
432	      const x = rng.int(1, r.w - 2) + r.x;
433	      const y = rng.int(1, r.h - 2) + r.y;
434	      genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'setTile', tile: COBWEB }], x, y, 2, 2);
435	    }
436	    // ② 墙侵蚀(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:36):Dither(0.85)+Blotches()+OnlyWalls(27)+
437	    //   SkipTiles(画族)+清墙/铺土墙 2
438	    genRect(st, rng, [
439	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'onlyWalls', types: [def.wall] }, ...wallTail(2),
440	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
441	    // ③ 第三段(WoodHouseBuilder.cs:37,曾整体缺失 C4):Dither(0.95)+
442	    //    OnlyTiles(30,321,158)+ClearTile——剥掉木/针叶/红木主题块
443	    genRect(st, rng, [
444	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.95 },
445	      { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [T.WOOD, TILE_BY_KEY['v_321_boreal_wood']!, TILE_BY_KEY['v_158_rich_mahogany']!] },
446	      { k: 'clearTile' },
447	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
448	    return;
449	  }
450	  if (theme === 'ice') {
451	    // ① 321→161→147(IceHouseBuilder.cs:29):Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+
452	    //   OnlyTiles(321)+SetTileKeepWall(161)+Dither(0.8)+SetTileKeepWall(147)
453	    genRect(st, rng, [
454	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
455	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: ICE161 },
456	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: SNOW147 },
457	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
458	    // ② 顶/底行钟乳石(IceHouseBuilder.cs:30-31):Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(161)+
459	    //   Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite,矩形 (X+1, 行, W-2, 1)
460	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
461	      genRect(st, rng, [
462	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [ICE161] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
463	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
464	    }
465	    // ③ 墙(IceHouseBuilder.cs:32,无 OnlyWalls):Dither(0.85)+Blotches(2,0.8)+
466	    //   SkipTiles(画族)+清墙/铺墙 40
467	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.8), ...wallTail(40)], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
468	    return;
469	  }
470	  if (theme === 'jungle') {
471	    // ① 158→60→59(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:29):Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+
472	    //   OnlyTiles(158)+SetTileKeepWall(60)+Dither(0.8)+SetTileKeepWall(59)
473	    genRect(st, rng, [
474	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
475	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: JUNGLE60 },
476	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: MUD59 },
477	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
478	    // ② 藤(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:30-31):Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(60)+Offset(0,1)+
479	    //   IsEmpty+ActionVines(3, H, 62)
480	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
481	      genRect(st, rng, [
482	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [JUNGLE60] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 },
483	        { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'vines', min: 3, max: r.h, vine: VINE62 },
484	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
485	    }
486	    // ③ 墙 64(JungleHouseBuilder.cs:32,无 OnlyWalls/SkipTiles)
487	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'placeWall', wall: 64 }], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
488	    return;
489	  }
490	  if (theme === 'mushroom') {
491	    // ① 190→70(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:27):Dither(0.7)+Blotches(2,0.5)+OnlyTiles(190)
492	    genRect(st, rng, [
493	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.7 }, B2(0.5), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
494	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: MUSH70 },
495	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
496	    // ② 顶/底行(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:28-29):Dither(0.6)+OnlyTiles(70)+
497	    //   Offset(0,-1)+IsEmpty+SetTile(71)
498	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
499	      genRect(st, rng, [
500	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [MUSH70] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: -1 },
501	        { k: 'isEmpty' }, { k: 'setTile', tile: SHROOM71 },
502	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
503	    }
504	    // ③ 墙清空(MushroomHouseBuilder.cs:30)
505	    genRect(st, rng, [{ k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'clearWall' }], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
506	    return;
507	  }
508	  if (theme === 'granite' || theme === 'marble') {
509	    // ① 369→368 / 357→367(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:28 / MarbleHouseBuilder.cs:28):
510	    //   Dither(0.6)+Blotches(2,0.6)+OnlyTiles(主题块)+SetTileKeepWall(368/367)
511	    const to = theme === 'granite' ? GRANITE368 : MARBLE367;
512	    genRect(st, rng, [
513	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.6 }, B2(0.6), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
514	      { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: to },
515	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
516	    // ② 顶/底行(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:29-30):Dither(0.8)+OnlyTiles(368/367)+
517	    //   Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite(名单外 no-op,但 Dither/PlaceTight 掷骰照耗)
518	    for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
519	      genRect(st, rng, [
520	        { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [to] }, { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
521	      ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
522	    }
523	    // ③ 墙 180/178(GraniteHouseBuilder.cs:31 / MarbleHouseBuilder.cs:31)
524	    genRect(st, rng, [
525	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.85 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'placeWall', wall: theme === 'granite' ? 180 : 178 },
526	    ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
527	    return;
528	  }
529	  // desert
530	  // ① 396→396→397(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:31):Dither(0.8)+Blotches(2,0.2)+
531	  //   OnlyTiles(396)+SetTileKeepWall(396)+Dither(0.5)+SetTileKeepWall(397)
532	  //   ——第一段写 396 是原版字面(视觉 no-op),但第二道 Dither 的掷骰位置在此
533	  genRect(st, rng, [
534	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, B2(0.2), { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [def.tile] },
535	    { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: def.tile },
536	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'setTileKeepWall', tile: HARDSAND397 },
537	  ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
538	  // ② 顶/底行钟乳石(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:32-33,曾整体缺失 C5):
539	  //   Dither(0.5)+OnlyTiles(397,396)+Offset(0,1)+ActionStalagtite
540	  for (const rowY of [r.y, r.y + r.h - 1]) {
541	    genRect(st, rng, [
542	      { k: 'dither', p: 0.5 }, { k: 'onlyTiles', types: [HARDSAND397, def.tile] },
543	      { k: 'offset', dx: 0, dy: 1 }, { k: 'stalagtite' },
544	    ], r.x + 1, rowY, r.w - 2, 1);
545	  }
546	  // ③ 墙 216(DesertHouseBuilder.cs:34):Dither(0.8)+Blotches()+OnlyWalls(187)
547	  genRect(st, rng, [
548	    { k: 'dither', p: 0.8 }, B2(0.3), { k: 'onlyWalls', types: [def.wall] }, { k: 'placeWall', wall: 216 },
549	  ], r.x, r.y, r.w, r.h);
550	}

552	// ---------- FillRooms(画/烛台交替 + 装饰循环) ----------
553	function fillRooms(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, r: Rect, def: ThemeDef, theme: Theme): void {
554	  // 家具七选(HouseBuilder.FillRooms choices;沙漠 Tables2 → tile 469)
555	  const choices: Array<[string, number]> = [
556	    [def.tables2 ? 'v_469_tables_group_2' : 'table', def.table],
557	    ['anvil', 0],
558	    ['workbench', def.workbench],
559	    ['v_86_loom', 0],
560	    ['piano', def.piano],
561	    ['keg', 0],
562	    ['bookcase', def.bookcase],
563	  ];
564	  // 画/烛台交替:switch(i + parity%2) 仅 0/1 两档有内容(i≥2 落空,原版同款)
565	  const n = Math.floor(r.w / 8);
566	  const step = Math.floor(r.w / (n + 1));
567	  const parity = rng.int(0, 1);
568	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
569	    const x = (i + 1) * step + r.x;
570	    if ((i + (parity % 2)) % 2 === 0) {
571	      // 画:Y + min(H/2, H-5)
572	      const y = r.y + Math.min(Math.floor(r.h / 2), r.h - 5);
573	      const [key, style] = theme === 'desert' ? randHousePictureDesert(rng) : randHousePicture(rng);
574	      if (placeFurniture(st, key, x, y, style) && key === 'v_245_paintings_2x3') {
575	        // 245 RandomStyleRange=4（TileObjectData.cs:4821）——PlaceObject→TileObject.Place
576	        // 恒掷 Main.rand.Next(4)（TileObject.cs:792，CanPlace 过门后；沙漠 245 同掷）
577	        rng.int(0, 3);
578	      }
579	    } else {
580	      // 烛台:顶行悬挂(原版 +54 点亮帧——本引擎烛台恒点亮,帧差不建模)
581	      const y = r.y + 1;
582	      placeFurniture(st, 'candelabra', x, y, rng.int(0, 5), 'top');
583	    }
584	  }
585	  // 装饰循环:W/8+3 件
586	  const decoCount = Math.floor(r.w / 8) + 3;
587	  for (let k = 0; k < decoCount; k++) {
588	    const x = rng.int(0, r.w - 4) + 1 + r.x;
589	    const y = r.y + r.h - 2;
590	    switch (rng.int(0, 3)) {
591	      case 0: // 小堆 185(PlaceSmallPile size1:style*18)
592	        if (!activeAt(st, x, y)) st.setTileSilent(x, y, SMALL_PILE, rng.int(31, 33) * 18, 0);
593	        break;
594	      case 1: // 骨堆 186
595	        placeFurniture(st, 'v_186_decos_3x2', x, y, rng.int(22, 25));
596	        break;
597	      case 2: // 雕像(statueList[Next(2, len)],陷阱雕像照接)
598	        placeStatue(st, x, y, rng.int(2, STATUE_LIST.length - 1));
599	        break;
600	      case 3: {
601	        const [key, style] = choices[rng.int(0, choices.length - 1)];
602	        placeFurniture(st, key, x, y, style);
603	        break;
604	      }
605	    }
606	  }
607	}

609	// ---------- 楼梯 / 门 / 平台 / 梁 ----------
610	/** CreateStairsList + PlaceStairs:相邻房间对角平台链 + 顶步 4×1 平台 + 斜坡 */
611	function placeStairs(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
612	  for (let i = 1; i < rooms.length; i++) {
613	    const cur = rooms[i], prev = rooms[i - 1];
614	    const leftGap = prev.x - cur.x;
615	    const rightGap = cur.x + cur.w - (prev.x + prev.w);
616	    let from: { x: number; y: number };
617	    if (leftGap > rightGap) from = { x: cur.x + cur.w - 1, y: cur.y + 1 };
618	    else from = { x: cur.x, y: cur.y + 1 };
619	    const steps = (cur.y + cur.h - 1) - from.y;
620	    const dir = leftGap > rightGap ? -1 : 1;
621	    for (let s = 0; s < steps; s++) {
622	      const sx = from.x + dir * (s + 1), sy = from.y + s;
623	      if (!st.inBounds(sx, sy)) continue;
624	      // 平台帧 = PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle)(HouseBuilder.cs:518)——case 19 走
625	      // frameY = 18*style(WorldGen.cs:60245-60249),非 frameX;曾恒写 (0,0)(C6)
626	      st.setTileSilent(sx, sy, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
627	      st.slope[st.idx(sx, sy)] = dir === 1 ? 1 : 2;
628	    }
629	    // 顶步上方 4×1 平台(HouseBuilder.cs:519)：Gen(Chain(Clear(), PlaceWall(WallType),
630	    //   PlaceTile(19)))——★PlaceWall 逐格走墙重帧掷（Actions.Clear 清 tile+wall+liquid
631	    //   后置墙 → 自格+四邻 SquareWallFrame 判定掷，尾批 2-C 墙掷模型）
632	    const px = from.x + (dir === 1 ? 1 : -4);
633	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4; dx++) {
634	      const cx = px + dx, cy = from.y - 1;
635	      if (!st.inBounds(cx, cy)) continue;
636	      st.setTileSilent(cx, cy, 0);
637	      st.liquid[st.idx(cx, cy)] = 0;
638	      st.liquidType[st.idx(cx, cy)] = 0;
639	      placeWallRolled(st, rng, cx, cy, def.wall);
640	      st.setTileSilent(cx, cy, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
641	    }
642	  }
643	}
644	
645	/** FindSideExit(Up 搜索 + AreaOr(4,3) 任一非实心) */
646	function findSideExit(st: TileStore, wallX: number, wallY: number, wallH: number, isLeft: boolean): number | null {
647	  const startX = wallX + (isLeft ? -4 : 0);
648	  for (let k = 0; k < wallH - 3; k++) {
649	    const y = wallY + wallH - 3 - k;
650	    let any = false;
651	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4 && !any; dx++) {
652	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3 && !any; dy++) {
653	        if (!solidAt(st, startX + dx, y + dy)) any = true;
654	      }
655	    }
656	    if (any) return y;
657	  }
658	  return null;
659	}

661	function placeDoors(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
662	  for (const r of rooms) {
663	    // 墙列矩形 (X, Y+1, 1, H-2)
664	    // 门禁（原版 PlaceTile(x, exitY)→PlaceDoor(j+1)，WorldGen.cs:31946）：mount
665	    // （exitY-1 实心）+ 地板（exitY+3 实心）缺一即不放门只留门洞——HouseBuilder
666	    // 的 forced=true 仅绕过首道空格门，门分支的锚点条件仍生效
667	    const tryDoor = (x: number, exitY: number) => {
668	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 3; dy++) st.setTileSilent(x, exitY + dy, 0);
669	      if (solidAt(st, x, exitY - 1) && solidAt(st, x, exitY + 3)) {
670	        placeDoorClosed(st, x, exitY, def.door);
671	      }
672	    };
673	    const exitR = findSideExit(st, r.x + r.w - 1, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, false);
674	    if (exitR !== null) tryDoor(r.x + r.w - 1, exitR);
675	    const exitL = findSideExit(st, r.x, r.y + 1, r.h - 2, true);
676	    if (exitL !== null) tryDoor(r.x, exitL);
677	  }
678	}

680	/** FindVerticalExit(Left 搜索 + AreaOr(3,5) 任一非实心) */
681	function findVerticalExit(st: TileStore, rectX: number, rectY: number, rectW: number, isUp: boolean): number | null {
682	  const startX = rectX + rectW - 3;
683	  const startY = rectY + (isUp ? -5 : 0);
684	  for (let k = 0; k < rectW - 3; k++) {
685	    const x = startX - k;
686	    let any = false;
687	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 3 && !any; dx++) {
688	      for (let dy = 0; dy < 5 && !any; dy++) {
689	        if (!solidAt(st, x + dx, startY + dy)) any = true;
690	      }
691	    }
692	    if (any) return x;
693	  }
694	  return null;
695	}

697	function placePlatforms(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
698	  const top = rooms[0], bot = rooms[rooms.length - 1];
699	  // 顶层顶壁(isUp:候选自壁上 5 格起);帧同楼梯(C6):HouseBuilder.cs:574
700	  //   PlaceTile(19, PlatformStyle) → frameY = 18*style
701	  const exitT = findVerticalExit(st, top.x + 2, top.y, top.w - 4, true);
702	  if (exitT !== null) {
703	    for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) st.setTileSilent(exitT + dx, top.y, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
704	  }
705	  if (rooms.length > 1) {
706	    const exitB = findVerticalExit(st, bot.x + 2, bot.y + bot.h - 1, bot.w - 4, false);
707	    if (exitB !== null) {
708	      for (let dx = 0; dx < 3; dx++) st.setTileSilent(exitB + dx, bot.y + bot.h - 1, PLATFORM, 0, def.platformStyle * 18);
709	    }
710	  }
711	}

713	/** CreateSupportBeamList + PlaceSupportBeams:6→4 步长梁列,落下一房顶/实心 */
714	function placeSupportBeams(st: TileStore, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef): void {
715	  const minX = Math.min(...rooms.map((r) => r.x));
716	  const maxX = Math.max(...rooms.map((r) => r.x + r.w)) - 1;
717	  let step = 6;
718	  while (step > 4 && (maxX - minX) % step !== 0) step--;
719	  for (let x = minX; x <= maxX; x += step) {
720	    for (let ri = 0; ri < rooms.length; ri++) {
721	      const r = rooms[ri];
722	      if (x < r.x || x >= r.x + r.w) continue;
723	      const bottom = r.y + r.h;
724	      let limit = 50;
725	      for (let rj = ri + 1; rj < rooms.length; rj++) {
726	        const r2 = rooms[rj];
727	        if (x >= r2.x && x < r2.x + r2.w) limit = Math.min(limit, r2.y - bottom);
728	      }
729	      if (limit <= 0) continue;
730	      let found = -1;
731	      if (limit < 50) found = bottom + limit; // 原版:num7<50 视为命中下一房顶
732	      else {
733	        for (let y = bottom; y < bottom + limit; y++) {
734	          if (solidAt(st, x, y)) { found = y; break; }
735	        }
736	      }
737	      if (found < 0) continue;
738	      const height = found - bottom;
739	      if (height > 1 && st.type[st.idx(x, bottom - 1)] !== PLATFORM) {
740	        for (let y = bottom; y < found; y++) st.setTileSilent(x, y, def.beam, 0, 0);
741	      }
742	    }
743	  }
744	}

746	// ---------- 主题专属件级联(PlaceBiomeSpecificPriorityTool / PlaceBiomeSpecificTool) ----------
747	/** HouseBuilder.cs:764-826/838-865/881-907 共形级联:逐房【底行 Y+H-2】先 10 次
748	 *  随机(Next(2,W-2)+X)再整行扫描;仅 Bast 有顶行 Y-1 兜底级联(:798-825)。
749	 *  任一命中即停(true = 放置成功,调用方据此递增计数)。
750	 *  旧实现是"rooms[0] 单发随机公式"——三级级联与逐房推进全部缺失(C7) */
751	function cascadePlace(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, rooms: Rect[], key: string, ceilingFallback: boolean): boolean {
752	  const tryRow = (r: Rect, y: number): boolean => {
753	    for (let t = 0; t < 10; t++) {
754	      if (placeFurniture(st, key, rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, y)) return true;
755	    }
756	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2; x++) {
757	      if (placeFurniture(st, key, x, y)) return true;
758	    }
759	    return false;
760	  };
761	  for (const r of rooms) if (tryRow(r, r.y + r.h - 2)) return true;
762	  if (ceilingFallback) {
763	    for (const r of rooms) if (tryRow(r, r.y - 1)) return true;
764	  }
765	  return false;
766	}

768	// ---------- 宝箱四级联(PlaceChests) ----------
769	function placeChests(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink, rooms: Rect[], def: ThemeDef, theme: Theme): void {
770	  const tryAt = (x: number, y: number): boolean => {
771	    const underground = y > gs.worldSurface;
772	    // 冰屋：显式 style 11 直入冰箱门（cs:36107 第一析取）→ 主件池 + 1/20 提炼机 +
773	    // 1/50 鱼覆盖块自动生效（旧实现显式 loot 绕过覆盖——审计三.4 修复）
774	    return placeBuriedChest(st, rng, gs, chests, x, y, {
775	      style: underground ? def.chestStyle : 0,
776	      tile: underground && def.chestTile2 ? CHEST2 : undefined,
777	      flags: theme === 'ice' ? { ice: true } : (!underground ? { wooden: true } : {}),
778	    });
779	  };
780	  // 级联 1:各房底行随机 10 次
781	  for (const r of rooms) {
782	    const floorY = r.y + r.h - 1;
783	    let ok = false;
784	    for (let t = 0; t < 10 && !ok; t++) ok = tryAt(rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, floorY);
785	    if (ok) return;
786	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2 && !ok; x++) ok = tryAt(x, floorY);
787	    if (ok) return;
788	  }
789	  // 级联 2:各房顶行(Y-1)
790	  for (const r of rooms) {
791	    const ceilY = r.y - 1;
792	    let ok = false;
793	    for (let t = 0; t < 10 && !ok; t++) ok = tryAt(rng.int(2, r.w - 3) + r.x, ceilY);
794	    if (ok) return;
795	    for (let x = r.x + 2; x <= r.x + r.w - 2 && !ok; x++) ok = tryAt(x, ceilY);
796	    if (ok) return;
797	  }
798	  // 级联 3:房外 ±30 随机 1000 次
799	  for (let t = 0; t < 1000; t++) {
800	    if (tryAt(rng.int(rooms[0].x - 30, rooms[0].x + 29), rng.int(rooms[0].y - 30, rooms[0].y + 29))) return;
801	  }
802	}
803	
804	// ---------- pass 主体 ----------
805	/** 地下小屋 pass(UndergroundHousesAndBuriedChests 的 CaveHouse 段,cs:17153-17192
806	 *  + 沙漠追加段 cs:17193-17219) */
807	/** pass 59 头四计数连掷(cs:17081-17084,序=CaveHouse→Underworld→CaveChest→
808	 *  AdditionalDesert)——本仓 pass 拆分后各消费 pass 流位分散,由本函数在管线中
809	 *  第一个消费 pass 之前统一预掷暂存 gs(WorldGen.ts 接线)。四枚均为
810	 *  WorldGenRange.GetRandom(WorldGenRange.cs:34-57:先缩放边界再截断):
811	 *  CaveHouse/CaveChest=35-40×WorldArea、Underworld=10-15×WorldWidth/4200、
812	 *  AdditionalDesert=2-2×WorldArea(恒掷一骰)。幂等:已预掷(≥0)直接返回。 */
813	export function rollHouseChestCounts(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
814	  if (gs.caveHouseCount >= 0) return;
815	  const area = (st.w * st.h) / 5040000;
816	  const wsc = st.w / 4200;
817	  gs.caveHouseCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * area), Math.trunc(40 * area));
818	  gs.underworldChestCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(10 * wsc), Math.trunc(15 * wsc));
819	  gs.caveChestCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(35 * area), Math.trunc(40 * area));
820	  gs.desertHouseCount = rng.int(Math.trunc(2 * area), Math.trunc(2 * area));
821	}

823	export function runCaveHousesPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink): void {
```

```
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Biomes.CaveHouse;

public class WoodHouseBuilder : HouseBuilder
{
	public WoodHouseBuilder(IEnumerable<Rectangle> rooms)
		: base(HouseType.Wood, rooms)
	{
		base.TileType = 30;
		base.WallType = 27;
		base.BeamType = 124;
		base.PlatformStyle = 0;
		base.DoorStyle = 0;
		base.TableStyle = 0;
		base.WorkbenchStyle = 0;
		base.PianoStyle = 0;
		base.BookcaseStyle = 0;
		base.ChairStyle = 0;
		base.ChestStyle = 1;
		PotentiallyConvertToSeedHouse();
		PotentiallyConvertToRainbowBrick();
		PotentiallyConvertToRainbowMossBlock();
	}

	protected override void AgeRoom(Rectangle room)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < room.Width * room.Height / 16; i++)
		{
			int x = WorldGen.genRand.Next(1, room.Width - 1) + room.X;
			int y = WorldGen.genRand.Next(1, room.Height - 1) + room.Y;
			WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(x, y), new Shapes.Rectangle(2, 2), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(), new Modifiers.Blotches(2, 2), new Modifiers.IsEmpty(), new Actions.SetTile(51, setSelfFrames: true)));
		}
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X, room.Y), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width, room.Height), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(0.85), new Modifiers.Blotches(), new Modifiers.OnlyWalls(base.WallType), new Modifiers.SkipTiles(SkipTilesDuringWallAging), ((double)room.Y > Main.worldSurface) ? ((GenAction)new Actions.ClearWall(frameNeighbors: true)) : ((GenAction)new Actions.PlaceWall(2))));
		WorldUtils.Gen(new Point(room.X, room.Y), new Shapes.Rectangle(room.Width, room.Height), Actions.Chain(new Modifiers.Dither(0.95), new Modifiers.OnlyTiles(30, 321, 158), new Actions.ClearTile(frameNeighbors: true)));
	}

	public override void Place(HouseBuilderContext context, StructureMap structures)
	{
		base.Place(context, structures);
		RainbowifyOnTenthAnniversaryWorlds();
	}
}
```

```
	public class Dither : GenAction
	{
		private double _failureChance;

		public Dither(double failureChance = 0.5)
		{
			_failureChance = failureChance;
		}

		public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
		{
			if (GenBase._random.NextDouble() >= _failureChance)
			{
				return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
			}
			return Fail();
		}
	}

	public class Flip : GenAction
```

```
	public static bool Gen(Point origin, GenShapeActionPair pair)
	{
		return pair.Shape.Perform(origin, pair.Action);

	public static bool Find(Point origin, GenSearch search, out Point result)
	{
		result = search.Find(origin);
		if (result == GenSearch.NOT_FOUND)
		{
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	public static void ClearTile(int x, int y, bool frameNeighbors = false)
	{
		Main.tile[x, y].ClearTile();
		if (frameNeighbors)
		{
			WorldGen.TileFrame(x + 1, y);
			WorldGen.TileFrame(x - 1, y);
			WorldGen.TileFrame(x, y + 1);
			WorldGen.TileFrame(x, y - 1);
		}
	}

	public static void ClearWall(int x, int y, bool frameNeighbors = false)
	{
		Main.tile[x, y].wall = 0;
		if (frameNeighbors)
		{
			WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(x + 1, y);
			WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(x - 1, y);
			WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(x, y + 1);
			WorldGen.SquareWallFrame(x, y - 1);
		}
	}

	public static void TileFrame(int x, int y, bool frameNeighbors = false)
	{
		WorldGen.TileFrame(x, y, resetFrame: true);
		if (frameNeighbors)
		{
			WorldGen.TileFrame(x + 1, y, resetFrame: true);
			WorldGen.TileFrame(x - 1, y, resetFrame: true);
			WorldGen.TileFrame(x, y + 1, resetFrame: true);
			WorldGen.TileFrame(x, y - 1, resetFrame: true);
		}
	}
```

```
using Microsoft.Xna.Framework;
using Terraria.WorldBuilding;

namespace Terraria.GameContent.Generation;

public class ActionVines : GenAction
{
	private int _minLength;

	private int _maxLength;

	private int _vineId;

	public ActionVines(int minLength = 6, int maxLength = 10, int vineId = 52)
	{
		_minLength = minLength;
		_maxLength = maxLength;
		_vineId = vineId;
	}

	public override bool Apply(Point origin, int x, int y, params object[] args)
	{
		int num = GenBase._random.Next(_minLength, _maxLength + 1);
		int i;
		for (i = 0; i < num && !GenBase._tiles[x, y + i].active(); i++)
		{
			GenBase._tiles[x, y + i].type = (ushort)_vineId;
			GenBase._tiles[x, y + i].active(active: true);
		}
		if (i > 0)
		{
			return UnitApply(origin, x, y, args);
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

````
```ts
/** SolidTile2（WorldGen.cs:70178）：active && tileSolid && slope==0 && !half && !actuator */
function solid2(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  return st.flags[i] !== 0 && genSolidType(st.type[i]) && st.slope[i] === 0 && st.half[i] === 0;
}

/** Place*Wall 族公共体：gate = 全格 !active && wall≠0（画作族真前置） */
function placeWallArt(st: TileStore, x0: number, y0: number, w: number, h: number, tile: number, fx: (dx: number) => number, fy: (dy: number) => number): boolean {
  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++) {
    if (!st.inBounds(x0 + dx, y0 + dy)) return false;
    const i = st.idx(x0 + dx, y0 + dy);
    if (st.flags[i] !== 0 || st.wall[i] === 0) return false;
  }
  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) for (let dy = 0; dy < h; dy++)
    st.setTileSilent(x0 + dx, y0 + dy, tile, fx(dx), fy(dy));
  return true;
}

/** 底承族公共体：cells !active + 每列下方 SolidTile2（+可选 boulders 拒绝） */
function placeFloorObject(st, x0, y0, w, h, tile, fx, fy, bouldersReject = false): boolean {
  for (let dx = 0; dx < w; dx++) {
    if (!solid2(st, x0 + dx, y0 + h)) return false;
    if (bouldersReject && isBoulder(st.type[st.idx(x0+dx, y0+h)])) return false;  — boulders = genSolid? no — TileID.Sets.Boulders {138,484,664,665,711-716}
  }
  for cells: if active return false
  place...
}

		}

		}
````

```
		{
			for (int j = num; j < y + 1; j++)

				if (Main.tile[i, j] == null)
```

```
CRITICAL SEMANTIC REVEALED:

`IsValid` with AreaType.Or:
- loops the area; if ANY cell `CheckValidity(i, j)` → return `!InvertResults`
- else → return `InvertResults`

For `IsSolid().Not()AreaOr(4,3)`: InvertResults=true.
- If ANY cell is SOLID (CheckValidity=true) → return !true = **FALSE** (the search does NOT match!)
- If NO cell is solid (all non-solid) → return true = **TRUE** (match!)

**AreaOr(4,3) with .Not() = "NO solid cell in the 4×3 area" — i.e., the area must be ENTIRELY NON-SOLID!!** NOT "any non-solid"!
```

```
    const y = wallY + wallH - 3 - k;

    for (let dx = 0; dx < 4 && !any; dx++) {
```
